name: Sin & Siege
description:
About This Game

Sin & Siege is a rogue-lite strategy that descends into the abyssal depths, casting you as Hell's Architect and Warden. Your sacred duty: to resurrect and rebuild the infernal circles, multiply demonic legions, and protect the Heart of Darkness from the Forces of Light at any cost.

Rituals of Construction and War

Each cycle is divided into growth and defense: alongside your devoted demons, you harvest dark souls—the very essence of Hell's power—extract Sins from them to erect structures and spawn warriors of the pit. The work in the Torture Chamber and the Brothel is enticing, but to neglect defense is fatal. Fortify your borders, breed your fighters, master forbidden incantations to repel the onslaught of the righteous and keep the Heart of Darkness inviolate.

The Seven Deadly Sins

All of Hell's machinery rests upon seven pillars—the Deadly Sins. Each sin fuels a distinct branch of the infernal economy: Sloth powers farms, manufactories, and quarries; Lust governs propagation. Souls burdened by a particular sin yield corresponding advantages: Gluttons multiply the output of farms, while the Slothful are compelled to toil faster.

The Calling of the Netherworld

Your task is not merely to withstand the celestial onslaught, but to establish Hell as an immutable, eternal engine of suffering and order, with you as its supreme architect and keeper.

Add Sin & Siege to your Wishlist. We await you in the darkness.
short_desc: Sin & Siege is a rogue-lite strategy where you must restore the shattered circles of Hell. Harvest and process sinful souls, amass Sins, forge new demons, populate the abyss, and defend it from holy monstrosities.
